paired_rule: Keep canonical Bituminous Blast library index as fixed physical slot; replace *only* the name/card model at that index; all variants share same seed and physical-ID shuffle trajectory until any actual fetch search. Initial 7 cards must match except for registered slot; post-fetch draws may legitimately diverge.

fixed_policy.game_type: Simplified four-player Commander environment, pilot's own turns only; other players' active turns, real responses, full effects and mulligans not modeled.
fixed_policy.mana: Only verified Cycle104 actual land mana, fetch, City, Ancient Tomb; no ritual/rock/nonland acceleration is autonomously used.
fixed_policy.land: Play first recognized physical land in hand (one per own turn); fetch on own main phase and take deterministic registered target; shock pay 2 life when safe.
fixed_policy.spell: Own main-phase controller, no unmodeled triggered card effects. If Abaddon is castable, cast him first from command on own turn; otherwise attempt exact in-hand tested slot using source-backed mana. At most one of those two per turn.
fixed_policy.prioritization: Always Abaddon first if castable; no tactical commander removal or tax unless separately specified.
fixed_policy.effect: Creature slot candidate cast enters battlefield only after four priority passes, then may tap on a *later* controller turn. No haste assumed. If any opponent removes source before its eligible tap, activation is unavailable.
fixed_policy.baseline: Bituminous Blast has printed cascade and creature target. Without modeled opponent creatures, even a mana-affordable in-hand Blast is recorded as a mana/timing opportunity with target unknown, NOT a legal cast or measured removal/cascade value.
fixed_policy.heartless: Only post-eligible tap, conditional nonprevented damage to all players floor(life/2); resolution persists if source removed after activation. No actual opponent policy probabilities, Solphim/Bloodletter multipliers, or game-end inference.
fixed_policy.tree: Only after eligible tap, conditional 0/13 toughness-to-target-life exchange with first opponent at fixed baseline life [40,39,31]; if source leaves before resolution, exchange fails. No counters/prevention/other toughness modifiers.
fixed_policy.followup: Only detect if an actual physical Boltwave or Flame Rift remains in hand and can meet exact colored mana from currently untapped verified sources. Cascade on a resulting followup stays UNKNOWN; never invent its outcome.
fixed_policy.unresolved: Treat every baseline printed-cascade offer, legality of opponent creature target, unmodeled followup spells, replacement/prevention, and opponent response probabilities as UNKNOWN, not a zero-value penalty.

hard_limits: Not a true commander-first total-game optimization or win rate; only observed cast/mana/activation opportunities under fixed land-only policy.
Do not treat chance of a card being seen in 240 trials as reliable tournament probability.
Do not count effect of Heartless/Tree as benefit absent Abaddon presence and follow-up legal hand cast.
Unknown target / printed cascade value for Bituminous cannot be compared to direct life-loss magnitudes.
Unsupported land-mana abilities and nonland acceleration are excluded; fail closed and report model incompleteness.
Leave M6 Phase B, Pass C/I/J, improvement and zero-improvement certifications unclosed.
acceptance: Exactly 100 physical IDs including one commander in all 720 variants; singleton except basics and exact named-slot replacement
Independent 240 matched opening seven-card hands per variant and source-hash verification
Oracle verify all four source card identities, mana cost, types, Bituminous printed cascade and targeting, source tap abilities and Abaddon hand-only cascade text
Zero fabricated blast cascade effects, no win-rate, no approved swap or M6 promotion
Test source survival before/after activation and Tree versus Heartless correct disappearance
Output per-variant counts conditional on truly drawn/held cards and actual land source payments; report unknown value explicitly, never rank by event volume
Reproducibility CI and M6-only change scope
